notes.text: The sheet carries the printed IHES letterhead and handwritten editorial references SGA 4 VII p. 20, SGA 4 IX p. 42, note pour la p. 8, and VII 2.1 c) (p. 9). The isolated lower-left 23 is recorded as an archive sheet number. No date or total page count is written.

notes.text: Item a adds algébrique, d. torsion to the description of X tilde et as localement cohérent, then writes a coherence/quasi-separation condition with sss. Several crossed words and ref placeholders remain. The precise final edited mathematical statement is not reconstructed from the corrections.
notes.basis: Observation of main a and crops 02–08. The d. expansion is recorded only in abbreviations; no proof or truth claim is supplied.

notes.text: Item b considers a filtered projective system (X_i) with affine transition morphisms, writes X as the inverse limit indexed by i, cites EGA IV 8, and gives the displayed equivalence using the written baseline name limtop over a left arrow.
notes.basis: Observation of half a and crops 09–10. Mathematical structure was used only to notice indices and arrow direction, not to repair them.

notes.text: The right marginal corollary contains two circled proposed substitutions, qu. cpt and resp. coh, plus a live doubtful parenthesis qu. sép/qu. sep. Its two cancellations remain uncertain or unreadable. The lower curved stroke below the first et is preserved without interpreting it as an overhead tilde.
notes.basis: Observation of crop 11. The relationship of corrections is preserved spatially; no reconstructed final corollary is asserted.
